title: Real-Time Collaboration Platform
summary: Presence, conflict resolution, and sync that degrades politely when the network does not. CRDT sync over Durable Objects — and what actually degrades first at ten thousand concurrent editors.

title: Multi-Tenant SaaS on Cloudflare
summary: Tenant isolation with Workers, D1 and R2. Routing at the edge, billing boundaries in the schema, and no shared state by accident.

title: AI Document Assistant / RAG
summary: Retrieval that can prove where an answer came from. Evaluation loops before feature loops; a retrieval pipeline that regressed quietly, and the eval harness that now catches it.

title: Agentic Workflow System Design
summary: Agents as narrow tools with contracts. Tool boundaries, checkpoints, human gates — autonomy budgeted as a governed resource.

title: Frontend Architecture for Enterprise Scale
summary: Module boundaries a new hire can learn in a week and a team can hold for five years. Ownership maps, dependency rules, and the small set of conventions worth enforcing by machine.
